texts.Demo:HeroSubtitle: A modern, RTL/LTR-aware Blazor component library with comprehensive theming support.
texts.Demo:IntroTagline: The complete Blazor component library for .NET 10 — built for the real world.
texts.Demo:IntroLead: SufiBlazor gives you 90+ production-ready components with design tokens, full RTL/LTR support, Light/Dark themes, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and zero dependency on Bootstrap or Tailwind. Build modern web apps that work everywhere.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilitiesLead: From buttons and forms to data grids and dialogs — every category is packed with components ready to drop into your app.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityActions: Buttons, icon buttons, and links. Variants, sizes, loading states, and full keyboard support.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityForms: Text fields, select, autocomplete, checkboxes, date/time/color pickers, sliders, file upload, and rich text editor.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityData: Powerful data grid with sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, virtualization, and inline editing. Plus tables, stat cards, and pagination.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityMaps: OpenStreetMap maps with Leaflet — interactive canvas, location previews, pickers, geolocation, and Nominatim place search.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityLayout: Stack, Grid, and Container. Responsive layouts that adapt to any screen.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityNavigation: Tabs, stepper, breadcrumb, accordion, nav menu, and tree view. Guide users through your app.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityOverlays: Dialogs, drawers, popovers, tooltips, context menus, and confirmation dialogs. Layer content without clutter.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityFeedback: Alerts, toasts, banners, badges, progress bars, skeleton loaders, and empty states. Keep users informed.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilitySurfaces: Cards and surfaces with elevation variants. Group content with clarity and style.
texts.Demo:IntroCapabilityTypography: Headings, text, and icons. Consistent typography across your entire UI.
texts.Demo:IntroWhyLead: Every component is designed for production: theming, RTL, accessibility, and zero external CSS.
texts.Demo:IntroExploreLead: Click any category to see live demos and copy-ready code examples.
texts.Demo:FeatureThemingDesc: Override colors, spacing, typography, and radius via CSS variables. Light and dark themes included — no Bootstrap or Tailwind needed.
texts.Demo:FeatureRtlDesc: Bidirectional layout with language-aware fonts. Latin, Arabic, and Persian — one codebase, any direction.
texts.Demo:FeatureA11yDesc: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. Keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA labels, and screen reader support built in.
texts.Demo:FeatureSelfContainedDesc: No Bootstrap or Tailwind. Add the package, add the CSS link — you're done. No framework lock-in.
texts.Demo:FeatureTestedDesc: bUnit tests across the library. Components that behave predictably under load and in production.
texts.Demo:FeatureResponsiveDesc: Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Layouts and components adapt to any viewport.
texts.Demo:IntroParagraph: SufiBlazor is a modern Blazor component library built for .NET 10. 90+ components, design tokens, RTL/LTR support, theming, and accessibility built in.
texts.Demo:IntroNextSteps: Use the sidebar to explore component demos, or head to Getting Started to integrate SufiBlazor into your Blazor Web App.
texts.Demo:GettingStartedDescription: Integrate SufiBlazor into your Blazor Web App in a few steps.
texts.Demo:GettingStartedPrereqsDesc: .NET 10 SDK and a Blazor Web App (Blazor WebAssembly or Blazor Server).
texts.Demo:GettingStartedStep1Desc: Add the SufiChain.SufiBlazor NuGet package to your Blazor project.
texts.Demo:GettingStartedStep2Desc: In your app's HTML (e.g. App.razor or index.html), add the stylesheet in the head and the script before closing body.
texts.Demo:GettingStartedStep3Desc: Add namespace usings in _Imports.razor and wrap your app (or root layout) with SbThemeProvider.
texts.Demo:QuickStartThen: Then add the CSS reference to your App.razor:

texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingDescription: Tests both error paths: ErrorBoundary (fatal UI crashes → blocking modal) and UserExceptionInformer (ABP-style async/backend errors → message dialog, adapted in SpComponentBase).
texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingThrowHandlerDesc: Unhandled → ErrorBoundary. Full-screen modal, Reload/Back to home only.
texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingBackendErrorDesc: Via ExecuteWithLoadingAsync → UserExceptionInformer. Message dialog; page stays usable.
texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingValidationErrorDesc: Same path as backend → UserExceptionInformer. ABP validation uses this flow.
texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingShow404Desc: Navigate to non-existent route → SufiAbpErrorPage (404). Formal error page with Back to home, Go back.
texts.Demo:ErrorHandlingShow403Desc: Navigate to forbidden route → SufiAbpErrorPage (403). Requires a role nobody has.
texts.Demo:ForbiddenDemoMessage: If you see this, you have the ForbiddenDemoRole (unexpected).
